# OpenAI tunnel-client v0.0.20

The hosted VoxBridge image copies the `tunnel-client` object binary from the official multi-platform image `ghcr.io/openai/tunnel-client:v0.0.20`, pinned in the repository-root `Dockerfile` to OCI index digest `sha256:333005e6f5df2760f1b9f06fe873f5fc629554218f68c91d9cfbfe467d0fb42b`.

`LICENSE` and `NOTICE` in this directory are copied verbatim from the official [`openai/tunnel-client` v0.0.20 tag](https://github.com/openai/tunnel-client/tree/v0.0.20) and are also installed in the container at `/usr/share/doc/openai-tunnel-client/`.
